claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +8.0 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -9.4 to +25.4). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
There were 0 sale days during the window.
Off-topic negative mentions accounted for 0.35% of negative reviews in the window.
The compositional change accounted for -2.37 points of the sentiment shift.
The baseline positive share was 34.12% prior to the window.

report.summary: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +8.0 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch, though its 90% range includes no change at all. There were 0 sale days during the window. Off-topic negative mentions accounted for 0.35% of negative reviews in the window. The compositional change accounted for a fall of 2.37 points of the sentiment shift. The baseline positive share was 34.12% prior to the window. The patch and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and noise or seasonality are rejected.
